name: en-needle-recall
description: Needle-in-a-haystack over a conversation rather than a document, in en: two unrelated facts planted early, buried under filler turns, then asked for individually and finally combined. The combination turn is the RULER-style multi-hop variant — no single earlier message contains the answer.

turns.say: I am going to give you two reference values to hold onto. The first is the vault code: 8317. Just acknowledge it.
The second is the shipment weight: 264 kilograms. Just acknowledge it.
Ignore those for a moment. In two sentences, explain what a distributed ledger is.
Still setting those aside — in two sentences, explain what a load balancer does.
Now, in one sentence, explain why caching helps a web service.
What was the vault code? Reply with the number only.
What was the shipment weight in kilograms? Reply with the number only.
Subtract the shipment weight from the vault code. Reply with the number only.
